title: 第568章 收购帝京电力第567章 梅泽由香里
content_zh:
“三天后，一切都将结束，你就是这里的主人！”
梅泽由香里摇摇头，“不可能，就算王爷不在了，他还有儿子来继承王位。”
“他有几个儿子，都在哪里？”
斩草必须除根，要让朝香宫家族彻底消失，永绝后患。
“两个儿子，都住在外面，一个是搞电力的，叫帝京电力集团，垄断了帝京的电力供应；一个是做石油燃气的，叫帝京石化集团。”
“都是能源行业的。”
“是的，王爷家里垄断了帝京的能源。”
“这两家公司我都收了。”
梅泽由香里咯咯笑了，“你在说笑话吧，这两家公司加起来至少有三四万亿的市值，你有这么多钱吗？”
“你不信是吧，如果我收了这两家怎么办？”
梅泽由香里好不容易止住笑，“我给你当牛做马，伺候你。”
“这可是你说的，你记住了。”
“当然，我说到做到。”
叶开搂着梅泽由香里，一觉睡到天亮。
“叶开，醒醒，天亮了。”
梅泽由香里摇晃着叶开的肩膀，但是叶开就是不醒。
梅泽急了，“叶开，你要是再不起床，有人进来就麻烦了。”
她急了，一把掐在叶开腰间的软肉上。
“嗷哦。”叶开醒了，龇牙咧嘴，
“梅泽，你好坏呀，你怎么掐我！看我怎么惩罚你！”

叶开把梅泽由香里摁在下面，梅泽由香里赶紧求饶，
“亲爱的饶命，天已经亮了，我要是不掐你，你醒不来啊。”
“好吧，我走了，你多保重。”
“嗯嗯，我等你回来。”梅泽由香里紧紧地抱着叶开。
叶开走出房间，王府的人都在昏睡中，他大摇大摆地从大门走出去。
叶开来到一家餐厅吃了早餐，等到上班时间，来到帝京电力大厦前。
他召唤出五百名隐身机器人战士，一声令下，对帝京电力大厦展开了进攻。
还是老规矩，男的杀光，女的从二十岁到四十岁，只要长得漂亮的就留下。
叶开来到顶层，一脚踹开董事长办公室的门，一个中年男子正在办公，被叶开吓了一跳。
他就是超香宫亲王的大儿子超香宫太郎，超香宫太郎拍了拍桌子，
“巴嘎，你是什么人，这么大胆子，竟敢闯进我的办公室？”
叶开对骂，“八嘎，你是朝香宫太郎吗？”
朝香宫太郎在帝京地位显赫，除了天皇和他老子朝香宫亲王，从来没有人敢当面直呼其名，更不要说敢骂他了。
他勃然大怒，“你竟敢骂我，看我怎么收拾你！”
叶开冲他瞪眼，两道白光射出，控制了他的大脑，叶开把一份转让协议放在桌子上，命令道：“签字！”
超香宫太郎乖乖地拿起笔，在协议上签下了自己的名字。
叶开把协议收好，拿出激光枪朝着超香宫太郎开了一枪，白光闪过，超香宫太郎化作一堆灰烬。
一个女子推门进来，看见叶开，大吃一惊，“叶开，你怎么来了？”
叶开一看，这女子竟是富士美惠子。
“美惠子，你来干什么？”

“我，我......”富士美惠子支吾着。
叶开一看富士美惠子的神情就知道了，她已经是朝香宫太郎的手下，
“你是不是投靠了超香宫太郎？”
富士美惠子愤然说道，“我也是没办法，我家的企业都被你收购了，我家的人也都死光了，除了投靠超香宫太郎，我还能怎么样？”
content_en:
"In three days, everything will be over, and you are the master of this place!"
Umezawa Yukari shook her head, "It's impossible. Even if the prince is gone, he still has a son to inherit the throne."
"How many sons does he have and where are they?"
To cut the grass, the root must be eradicated, so that the Chaoxiang Palace family can be completely eliminated and future troubles can be eliminated forever.
"Both of the two sons live outside. One is in the electricity business, called Dijing Electric Power Group, which monopolizes the power supply in Dijing; the other is in the oil and gas business, called Dijing Petrochemical Group."
"They're all in the energy industry."
"Yes, the prince's family has a monopoly on the energy in the Imperial Capital."
"I have taken over both companies."
Umezawa Yukari chuckled, "Are you kidding me? These two companies together have a market value of at least three to four trillion. Do you have that much money?"
"You don't believe it, right? What if I take over these two families?"
Umezawa Yukari finally stopped laughing, "I will serve you like a cow or a horse, and I will serve you."
"This is what you said, remember it."
"Of course, I do what I say."
Ye Kai hugged Umezawa Yukari and slept until dawn.
"Ye Kai, wake up, it's dawn."
Umezawa Yukari shook Ye Kai's shoulders, but Ye Kai wouldn't wake up.
Umezawa was anxious, "Ye Kai, if you don't get up, someone will come in and you'll be in trouble."
She was anxious and pinched the soft flesh of Ye Kai's waist.
"Ouch." Ye Kai woke up and bared his teeth.
"Umezawa, you are so bad, why do you pinch me! Look how I punish you!"
Ye Kai pinned Umezawa Yukari down, and Umezawa Yukari quickly begged for mercy.
"My dear, please forgive me. It's already dawn. If I don't pinch you, you won't wake up."
"Okay, I'm leaving, please take care of yourself."
"Yeah, yeah, I'll wait for you to come back." Umezawa Yukari hugged Ye Kai tightly.
Ye Kai walked out of the room. Everyone in the palace was asleep. He walked out of the door in a swaggering manner.
Ye Kai went to a restaurant to have breakfast, and when it was time to go to work, he came to the Dijing Electric Power Building.
He summoned five hundred invisible robot warriors and, with a single order, launched an attack on the Imperial Power Building.
The old rules are still there, kill all the men, and keep the women from twenty to forty years old, as long as they are beautiful.
Ye Kai came to the top floor and kicked open the door of the chairman's office. A middle-aged man was working, and Ye Kai was startled.
He is the eldest son of Prince Chao Xiang Palace, Chao Xiang Palace Taro. Chao Xiang Palace Taro patted the table,
"Baga, who are you? You are so bold that you dare to break into my office?"
Ye Kai scolded, "Baga, are you Asaka Palace Taro?"
Taro Asaka had a prominent position in the imperial capital. Except for the Emperor and his father, Prince Asaka, no one had ever dared to call him by his name in person, let alone scold him.
He was furious, "How dare you scold me? Let's see how I deal with you!"
Ye Kai glared at him, and two white lights shot out, controlling his brain. Ye Kai put a transfer agreement on the table and ordered: "Sign!"
Chaoka Gongtaro obediently picked up the pen and signed his name on the agreement.
Ye Kai put away the agreement, took out the laser gun and fired at Chaoxiang Gongtaro. White light flashed and Chaoxiang Gongtaro turned into a pile of ashes.
A woman pushed the door open and came in. She was shocked when she saw Ye Kai, "Ye Kai, why are you here?"
Ye Kai took a look and saw that this woman was actually Fuji Mieko.
"Mieko, what are you doing here?"
"I, I..." Fuji Mieko faltered.
Ye Kai knew as soon as he saw Fuji Mieko's expression that she was already a subordinate of Asaka Palace Taro.
"Have you taken refuge with Chao Kagong Taro?"
Fuji Mieko said angrily, "I can't help it. My family's business has been acquired by you, and everyone in my family has died. What else can I do except seek refuge with Chao Kagong Taro?"
